title: 第11章 嫌疑人死亡（求月票）
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

次日清晨，许景川起床后洗漱完换上了昨天新领的警服。

那件沾血的外套昨天晚上来租房的路上就已经扔了，又还没去买换洗衣服，因此今天只能穿制服。

他身形本来就很魁梧，加上五官俊朗、眼神锐利，穿上警服后更多了一种正气凛然的可靠感和威慑力。

看着镜子中截然不同的自己。

许景川咧嘴一笑。

随即压了压帽檐出门。

白天走在东城区的街道上更能清晰感受到这里跟另外三个区、特别是跟西城区的区别。

干净、敞亮，路边还有绿植。

街上的车辆明显增多，行人基本上个个都衣着整齐，甚至还有牵狗遛鸟的，警察巡逻的频率也更高。

“嘟嘟！”

身后突然传来一阵喇叭声。

许景川循声望去，只见一辆白色轿车缓缓靠边停稳，接着车窗降下去露出周静那张明眸皓齿的脸蛋。

“许警官这是去上班？要不要我载你一程？”周静笑盈盈的问道。

“那我可就不跟周姐客气了。”许景川开朗的笑道，走到副驾驶拉开车门坐了进去。

关上门后一脸好奇的摸着椅子和仪表台，“托周姐的福，我还是头一次坐那么好的车呢，不便宜吧？”

其实他认识这车，第三区生产的星驰e5，低配版都要十来万，普通白领得不吃不喝十几年才买得起。

周静比他预料中还富婆啊！

不止有两套高档公寓那么简单。

“我也不太清楚，我先生送给我的三十岁生日礼物。”周静熟练的启动车辆，提到丈夫时神色不太自然。

许景川闻言只能在心里对那位日后的同道前辈说声抱歉了，作为后进晚辈我将来不仅要开你的车。

还要开你的车。

表面上却震惊道：“周姐你有三十岁了？开玩笑吧，我以为你只大我两三岁，最多才二十四五呢！”

这话倒也不全是吹捧。

可能是天生丽质，也可能是保养得好，周静看起来只有二十多岁。

“真的假的？逗我开心呢。”周静嘴上不信，脸上却笑开了花，不断扬起的嘴角根本压不住。

接着又半是玩笑半是试探的说了一句，“今年刚满的三十，现在知道了我真实年龄，不会嫌姐姐老吧？”

周静昨晚看过许景川的警官证。

知道他今年才二十二岁。

当初她舞蹈学院没毕业就嫁给了一个大自己三十多岁的男人做续弦。

老公年龄大就算了。

还体弱多病。

巧妇也难为无米之炊啊。

所以她自打结婚后，守了近乎十年的活寡，夜夜指日高升。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

Early the next morning, Xu Jingchuan got up, washed up and put on the new police uniform he received yesterday.

The bloody coat was thrown away on the way to the rental house last night, and I hadn't bought a change of clothes yet, so I could only wear my uniform today.

He was already very burly, with handsome features and sharp eyes. After putting on the police uniform, he gained an even more upright sense of reliability and intimidation.

Look at a completely different version of yourself in the mirror.

Xu Jingchuan grinned.

Then he pressed the brim of his hat and went out.

Walking on the streets of Dongcheng District during the day, you can clearly feel the difference between this place and the other three districts, especially Xicheng District.

Clean, open and bright, with green plants on the roadside.

There are significantly more vehicles on the street, almost all pedestrians are neatly dressed, and there are even some walking dogs and birds, and police patrols are more frequent.

"Dudu!"

Suddenly there was a blast of horns from behind.

Xu Jingchuan followed the sound and saw a white car slowly pulling over to the side and then lowering the window to reveal Zhou Jing's face with bright eyes and white teeth.

"Officer Xu, are you going to work? Do you want me to give you a ride?" Zhou Jing asked with a smile.

"Then I won't be polite to Sister Zhou." Xu Jingchuan smiled cheerfully, walked to the passenger seat, opened the door and got in.

After closing the door, he touched the chair and the dashboard with a curious look on his face, "Thanks to Sister Zhou, this is the first time for me to ride in such a good car. Isn't it cheap?"

In fact, he knew this car. The Xingchi e5 produced in District 3 costs over 100,000 yuan for the low-end version, and ordinary white-collar workers would have to go without food and drink for more than ten years to afford it.

Zhou Jing is a richer woman than he expected!

It’s more than just two high-end apartments.

"I don't know much about it. It was a 30th birthday gift from my husband." Zhou Jing skillfully started the car and looked unnatural when she mentioned her husband.

Hearing this, Xu Jingchuan could only say sorry to his future colleague in his heart. As a junior, I will not only drive your car in the future.

And drive your car.

On the surface, he was shocked and said: "Sister Zhou, are you thirty years old? Are you kidding me? I thought you were only two or three years older than me, maybe twenty-four or five at most!"

This is not entirely flattering.

Maybe it's her natural beauty, or maybe she's well-maintained, but Zhou Jing looks like she's only in her twenties.

"Really or not? You're making me happy." Zhou Jing said she didn't believe it, but her face burst into laughter, and she couldn't suppress the rising corners of her mouth.

Then he said, half jokingly and half tentatively, "I just turned thirty this year. Now that you know my true age, you won't think my sister is old, right?"

Zhou Jing saw Xu Jingchuan's police officer certificate last night.

I know he is only twenty-two years old.

Before she graduated from dance school, she married a man who was more than thirty years older than her.

It doesn’t matter if my husband is older.

Also frail and sickly.

Even a clever woman cannot make a meal without rice.

Therefore, after she got married, she remained a widow for nearly ten years, rising every night.
